# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## 1. Loop Drawing
*Draw a single continuous loop through the grid*
- Masyu
- Slitherlink
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Yajilin

## 2. Path & Connection Drawing
*Draw paths, lines, or bridges connecting elements*
- Numberlink
- Hashiwokakero
- Pencils

## 3. Cell Shading (Black/White Determination)
*Determine which cells to shade black based on numeric or structural constraints*
- Nurikabe
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Heyawake
- Akari
- Norinori
- Hitori
- Nurimisaki
- Nurimeizu
- Nuritwin
- Usowan

## 4. Region Division & Partitioning
*Divide the grid into regions or blocks following specific rules*
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Fillomino
- Double Choco
- Sashigane
- LITS

## 5. Shape Placement & Painting
*Place shapes, paint regions, or fill cells with specific geometric constraints*
- Choco Banana
- Shakashaka
- Tilepaint
- Chained Block
- Sto-stone
- Evolomino

## 6. Number Placement
*Fill cells with numbers according to arithmetic or positional rules*
- Sudoku
- Nansuke
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Juosan

## 7. Object Movement & Placement
*Move or position objects within the grid*
- Satogaeri
- Yosenabe
- Hebi
